comparison.objective: String a model recurve bow using a bow stringer and release it safely; candidate commissions an industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests bimanual management of flexible elements under stored elastic energy; candidate tests rigid-body tool insertion, counterholding, fine collar rotation, locking torque, and dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the bow remain correctly strung after release; candidate requires two repeatable non-bottoming stops and no setting drift.
comparison.reason: Flexible string routing and elastic loading are materially different from rigid damper adjustment and impact validation. The record has no specs or explicit release, damage, or string-seating thresholds.
